preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
For each test case, the number of vertices n must be between 1 and 400,000, and the number of operations k must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: sum(n for n, k in test_cases) <= 400000
preconditions.description: The total number of vertices across all test cases must not exceed 400,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of remaining vertices after applying k operations.
The number of remaining vertices must be non-negative.

postconditions.expression: remaining_vertices == 0 if n == 1 or n == 2 else remaining_vertices > 0
postconditions.description: If the tree has 1 or 2 vertices, the remaining vertices must be 0; otherwise, the remaining vertices must be greater than 0.
